coverage.unit: region invocations with directly observed synchronization
coverage.contract: One obligation per synchronization-bearing invocation; child obligations remain separate. Credits follow completion and are never reused or banked. Coverage allocations are accounting witnesses, not native producer matches.

contract: Observed CPU checkpoint order, not proof of necessary dependency. No condition argument: markers follow original control flow. Publish precedes the real release; waited follows observed readiness. IDs/generations are process-scoped. GPU submission alone is not GPU completion.

implementationSynchronization.contract: CPU synchronization called directly by the explicitly excluded native-GX module is emulator implementation evidence, not an application wait obligation. Raw records are retained. CUDA synchronization and all other callers remain in scope.

claims.term: I[peer_active == 1 and (serial == 1 or chunks + 1 > concurrent_budget)] * Wait[lmc.disk.read.large]

interfaceChecks.contract: Explicit indicators predict completed-wait occurrence per invocation, including zero occurrences; not blocked duration. Markers have no condition argument. Multiplicity is fitted separately on active invocations. Native coverage uses invocation budgets, not inferred object pairing. Only captured executions are checked.
